vectors.name: set_policy
vectors.note: mtx_set_policy(op, auth, policy uint8): the set_policy action under op code 10, signed params [KEYOP_SET_POLICY 6, policy] (POLICY_PASSKEY_FOR_VALUE = 1); a wallet-kind key may sign

vectors.name: set_guardian_msig
vectors.note: msig UA (algorand-address alice, wallet signature by her current authority + ed25519 erin), guardian none

vectors.name: start_recovery
vectors.note: mtx_start_recovery(op, auth, key, origin): from = the guardian (alice, wallet signature), to = the subject; finish after 172,800 s adds the key (CTR-ACC-03)

vectors.name: finish_recovery
vectors.note: mtx_finish_recovery(op, auth): the finish_recovery action under op code 11, signed params [KEYOP_FINISH_RECOVERY 7]; adds the recovery key, removes none

vectors.name: cancel_recovery
vectors.note: mtx_cancel_recovery(op, auth): no params

vectors.name: mandate_open
vectors.note: mtx_mandate_open(token 1001, op, auth, terms, fund_mbr): owner erin signs the funding token.mtx_pay (relayer = to = the mandate app, pay_ref = the mandate id, extra = sha256(token id ‖ id ‖ terms)); delegate carol (UA), payee bob, per payment 100, per period 250 per 86,400 s, funding 1,000 = amount

vectors.name: mandate_pay
vectors.note: mtx_mandate_pay(token 1001, op, auth): from = the mandate id, signed by the delegate carol; the mandate's lane payLane(pay_ref) at nonce 0 (each pay_ref once per (token, mandate))

vectors.name: mandate_revoke
vectors.note: mtx_revoke(token 1001, op, auth): the delegate's kill switch (the owner may sign it too); the remaining funds go back to the owner

vectors.name: trade_a
vectors.note: mtx_trade leg of order A on token 1001 (erin sells 100 for >= 50 of token 1007, order relayer bound to RELAYER): to = relayer = the DEX app address, amount = sell_amount, extra = sha256(ARC-4(Order))

vectors.name: trade_b
vectors.note: mtx_trade leg of order B on token 1007 (carol sells 60 for >= 100 of token 1001, open relayer); order lane nonce 3 (any nonce >= min_nonce)

vectors.name: cancel
vectors.note: mtx_cancel(op, auth, target_lane, target_nonce): closes erin's open order (lane c0, nonce 5); a filled, cancelled or voided order is refused

vectors.name: invalidate_nonces
vectors.note: mtx_invalidate_nonces(op, auth, lane, min_nonce): voids erin's orders below nonce 10 on lane c0; min_nonce < 2^63, strictly increasing (CTR-DEX-10)

signing.form: "MX" ‖ text, ed25519verify_bare by the current authority (AcctAuthAddr, else the address)

secp256k1.form: ecdsa_verify Secp256k1 over the op digest (kind 0x0108 raw digest), low s; v is the recovery id (ecdsa_pk_recover)
